svg.title: Sliding window over the example mjqjpqmgbljsphdztnvjfqwrcgsmlb with size 4
svg.desc: Each row is one loop iteration. The blue cells are the window from l to r. When the next character is new, r grows; when it is already in the window, l moves right. The loop ends when the window holds 4 different characters, with r equal to 7.

g.text: A two-pointer window that never holds a repeat
blue: window [l, r) · outlined: the character at r being tested
window = line[l:r] · counts kept in a 26-slot array indexed by byte % 26 (unique for a … z)
